prompts.normal:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one polished transparent dungeon map-node icon for the game Slay the Math.
Create exactly ONE framed NORMAL ENEMY icon, centered, NOT a sheet.
Reference 1: the source game's parchment/navy/antique-brass visual language, not its layout or text.
Reference 2: the existing angular bronze/crystal dungeon art style, not a particular enemy portrait.

DELIVERY: request a Full HD 1920 x 1080 landscape PNG canvas, genuine alpha transparency outside the badge, one centered medallion. No simulated checkerboard, no solid-color backdrop. The icon is large, about 880 pixels tall at center (960,540), with comfortable transparent padding. Front-on orthographic UI asset, absolutely no perspective tilt.

SHARED FRAME DESIGN, to become the identical master frame for all SIX categories: a perfectly circular, moderately thick beveled dark gunmetal rim, one thin continuous antique-gold outer edge and one thin antique-gold inner edge. Four small, identical diamond-shaped antique-gold inlays at precisely 12, 3, 6, and 9 o'clock, integrated flush into the circular rim; a restrained engraved geometric pattern, no sprawling filigree. Dark matte navy recessed circular face inside the rim. Strictly balanced radial geometry and one uniform frame thickness. No category-specific ornaments attached to the frame. Frame is always gunmetal and antique gold, regardless of category. Restrained and premium, matching the source dungeon rather than excessively ornate.

NORMAL ENEMY SYMBOL: two bold short crossed dungeon swords in a clean X silhouette, with one small faceted ruby-red diamond where they intersect. The blades use deep crimson red faces, bright ruby edge accents, subdued ivory-metal cutting edges, and small antique gold guards. Strong immediately readable silhouette. Red is the dominant category color INSIDE the frame, with a very subtle red halo contained entirely within the recessed disc. No skull, crown, shield, horn, numbers, words or letters for this basic enemy. The crossed swords should be clear when the icon is downscaled to 48px.

STYLE: high-quality hand-painted 2D fantasy RPG interface art with crisp beveled edges, disciplined shading, attractive readable material separation, strong center symbol, simplified details. No photorealism, no busy background, no game screenshot, no labels, no watermark, no drop shadow or color glow outside the frame. All empty canvas outside the circular frame must be truly transparent.
prompts.elite:
Use case: precise-object-edit. One transparent fantasy RPG map icon, NOT an icon sheet.
INPUT IMAGE is the approved NORMAL ENEMY MEDALLION MASTER and is the edit target. Preserve its exact circular gunmetal-and-antique-gold FRAME: same outer silhouette, same rim thickness, same double gold edges, same engraving, same four cardinal gold diamond ornaments, same angle, lighting, dimensions and center alignment. The frame itself stays neutral gunmetal and gold for EVERY category. Do not add crowns, wings, horns, ribbons, extra gems or category-specific decorations to the FRAME; all category artwork must remain inside the existing circular face.
CHANGE ONLY the artwork inside the recessed disc and its inner category color, as specified below. Remove both crossed swords and their ruby central diamond completely. Keep the icon a clean, front-facing game UI medallion in the same hand-painted 2D fantasy material style as the master.
Canvas: Full HD 1920 x 1080 requested, landscape 16:9, same centered badge footprint as the master. Real alpha transparency outside the medallion, no fake checkerboard, no black/white/color background, no rectangular panel. Clean antialiased edges. Preserve existing transparency. Restrained inner glow, no glow outside the rim. No words, labels, numbers, watermark, UI screenshot, extra icons, or multiple variants. Strong readable center silhouette at 48px.

ELITE ENEMY, RED category: replace the center with a bold symmetrical angular BEAST MASK sculpted from deep crimson/ruby crystal, with two short swept horns and a strong brow, bright red eyes, one small geometric forehead facet and limited ivory/gold edge highlights. This is a more dangerous dungeon beast symbol, not a full-body enemy, not a sword and not a crown. Single instantly readable mask silhouette, deep burgundy inner disc and contained red light. Exactly the same master frame; horns must fit comfortably inside its circular face.
